scope: Read-only current ClientPointer, XI2 ButtonClass counts, actual XI1 slave/master maps, core-map cross-check and per-device mapping-change observation on the existing native physical point/source proof; no move/click dispatch

initial_results.finding: Additional test used pytest-reserved parameter name request. Renamed to kind; runtime source and assertions unchanged.

button_contract.device_identity: Existing XTEST source and pointer master on the same input monitor; actual ClientPointer must be set and equal master; never selects or mutates it
button_contract.maps: XI1 GetDeviceButtonMapping for both devices with exact count/length/reply type, cross-check core GetPointerMapping against master
button_contract.composition: For each actual source physical code, apply slave map then master map; choose lowest code whose final logical button is primary 1. Disabled and out-of-master-range intermediate codes cannot be candidates. Aliases accepted deterministically.
button_contract.identity: SHA256 of full source/master bytes, lengths and IDs; double reads and later read bracketed by existing focus, native point, physical release and source guards. Padding excluded; same-effect remaps still invalidate.
button_contract.logical_release: QueryPointer same screen/root and zero logical mask, alongside pre-existing all-device held-state checks

notification_contract: QueryExtension first_event + 11 for XI1 DeviceMappingNotify; parser bound to both real device IDs before void SelectExtensionEvent on root, then ClientPointer barrier. Core MappingNotify also latches. No own-event exemption. Notification while subscribing, malformed/unbound event, failure or cancellation revokes old plan; restored maps never clear the latch.

protocol_sources.scope: FixUpEventForMaster maps slave physical detail before constructing master event
Master button map and pointer class copy; button actions/feedback/valuators require separate proof
Per-device mapping changes and separate core/XI1 notifications
PickPointer lazily stores ClientPointer on prior core queries
XI1 mapping event offset 11 and binary protocol structure

native_configuration: All native connections/replies injected; actual existing binary readers, window/source/point guards and business key/text callers exercised. Frozen imports and hashes checked before/after. Default offline guard retained. Windows asyncio approved outside sandbox; no real device, service stop, account change or environment rebuild.
